target_claim_note: This registry selects and dependencies the first legal B2 owner work; it executes no source, action, vacuum, quotient, anomaly, datum, prediction, confirmation or scientific verdict.
selection_rule: Rank substantial arcs by counterfactual program effect and present decidability; treat a named requirement as a dependency rather than a solved object; select the earliest owner whose output is consumed by the greatest number of later arcs.

arcs.physics_endpoint: one target-blind pre-density action class with stationary selected vacuum, global stabilizer, complete Hessian and source-native symmetry-breaking orbit
arcs.first_gate: Qualify the W154/W229 conditional branch-3 action as a materially distinct pre-density K77 candidate before any N2-N3-N6 execution: type its real-signature horn, fields, coefficients, complete Euler/Hilbert map and target-blind freeze, and refuse silent K95-to-K77 transfer.
arcs.positive_continuation: If a real-typed, coefficient-complete K77 owner survives, execute N2 AND N3 AND N6 on that frozen class, then preserve N1, N4 and N5.
arcs.negative_continuation: If it fails qualification, bank a precise non-admission for this branch-3 class and reselect; do not synthesize CBRS-1AC or infer a universal action no-go.
arcs.cheapest_decisive_condition: a canonical real Spin(9,5)-to-Spin(7,7) action bridge or a native K77 restatement with independently owned coefficients and complete variational roles

arcs.physics_endpoint: one observed 3+1 carrier, interacting BV/BFV quotient, common Lorentzian positive reduced domain and relative index/count map
arcs.first_gate: Freeze PHQ-1 from a surviving stationary selected background before composing quotient, domain, index, anomaly or observed-count owners.
arcs.positive_continuation: Build the interacting physical complex and common domain on the same frozen background.
arcs.negative_continuation: A failed stationary owner returns to arc 1; a quotient failure closes only the frozen quotient route.
arcs.cheapest_decisive_condition: nontrivial reduced cohomology with a conserved positive pairing on one common Lorentzian domain
arcs.claim_ceiling: physicalization of one frozen conditional class

arcs.physics_endpoint: source-native composed Higgs orbit, complete mass operators and observed scalar, vector, neutral and constrained-RS spectra
arcs.first_gate: Compose the observation map with the later connection-curvature action on the frozen physical quotient; do not substitute a conventional VEV-only model.
arcs.positive_continuation: Compute full Hessian/pole data and observed descent without target fitting.
arcs.negative_continuation: Close only the frozen source-native realization and retain differently typed action or quotient routes.
arcs.cheapest_decisive_condition: one light observed doublet plus massive or removed forced companions on the common quotient
arcs.claim_ceiling: conditional spectrum fit, never source derivation or prediction

arcs.physics_endpoint: native Yang--Mills horn and branching with relative normalization/thresholds plus action-owned strong-field and PPN dynamics
arcs.first_gate: Separate the external absolute scale from source-owned dimensionless horn, branching and ratio calculations; freeze the branch before observed targets are read.
arcs.positive_continuation: Run threshold, strong-field and PPN predictions from one action-owned branch.
arcs.negative_continuation: A missing ABS-1 remains external residue and cannot be replaced by a Ward identity; a failed branch closes only that frozen branch.
arcs.cheapest_decisive_condition: one frozen K77-to-observed branching with source-computed inverse-squared normalization
arcs.claim_ceiling: conditional normalized branch with external absolute scale explicit

arcs.physics_endpoint: one normalized action-owned cosmology and K77-to-observed thermodynamic bridge evaluated against frozen held-out consequences
arcs.first_gate: Freeze one normalized physical system and direct forward model before likelihood or thermodynamic evaluation.
arcs.positive_continuation: Evaluate the preserved equilibrium/entropy-production fork and preregistered cosmological likelihoods without retuning.
arcs.negative_continuation: Retain corrected H0, CPL, vacuum-decomposition, neutron-EDM and Jacobson scopes; no literature tension discharges construction.
arcs.cheapest_decisive_condition: one held-out consequence on a common action-owned domain

arcs.physics_endpoint: settled-K77 twisted degree-fifteen bordism/eta result and a separately typed nonzero framed or String integer detector paired with external P3
arcs.first_gate: Freeze the operative K77 boundary gauge group, full fermion content and real twist; do not import the K95 BSp(64) calculation.
arcs.positive_continuation: Compute the exact twisted bordism/eta class, then separately construct a nonzero corner and integer detector.
arcs.negative_continuation: A zero or absent class closes only that frozen twist; ordinary Spin torsion is not relabelled as an integer count.
arcs.cheapest_decisive_condition: a real-typed K77 twist with a nonzero or exactly trivialized degree-fifteen class
arcs.claim_ceiling: typed topological result; P3 remains external and no count is inferred

coverage.row_assignment: each of the 52 B2 rows is assigned exactly once to its dominant substantial arc; cross-arc dependencies are recorded in depends_on rather than by duplicating rows

selected_first_owner_gate.why_selected: It is the only named materially distinct conditional action candidate in the current requirement surface and sits upstream of the highest-fanout row set; its K95 signature and H41-unbuilt ceiling make qualification, not assumption, the honest first gate.
selected_first_owner_gate.execution_question: Does the branch-3 action admit a canonical real-typed K77 restatement with source-owned coefficients, complete pre-density Euler/Hilbert roles and a target-blind freeze sufficient to enter N2-N3-N6 testing?
selected_first_owner_gate.forbidden_inference: W154/W229 is not presumed portable, complete, K77-native, source-owned or successful. The first-action CBRS-1 class remains owner-exhausted and no synthetic CBRS-1AC is admitted.

Every other substantial arc consumes its frozen action/background or physical-quotient output, while ABS-1 and external P3 are explicit external residues rather than independently selectable scheduled constructions.
